_meta.principle: Reference-driven generation. Modern pipelines lock identity / style / product / layout via reference images, not prose. Each reference TYPE has a different semantic — composer threads the right type through the right field per-model. Style-ref, character-ref, product-ref, layout-ref are NOT interchangeable.
sources: Black Forest Labs FLUX prompting guide (multi-image refs for identity)
Runway Gen-4 prompting guide (@[character] @[style] reference syntax)
OpenAI image generation guide (image_urls for edit/reference workflows)
Google Imagen reference guide (style transfer + subject consistency)
Adrian's Puck v3 production lesson (lock product appearance via 1-3 ingredient images, never prose)
Adrian's KDP coloring book production (locked content-pipeline line-art reference across all 30 pages)
_meta.interpolation_rule: References are NOT prompt fragments — they're URL-threaded inputs that go in the model's reference field. Composer reads per-model-quirks.json `reference_field` + `reference_max` to thread correctly. Mention the reference role in prompt only if model-specific guide recommends it (NB2 uses inline @img1; FLUX/Imagen describe style in prose AND attach ref).

style_ref_locked_aesthetic.name: Style reference (locked aesthetic across batch)
style_ref_locked_aesthetic.use: When the same illustration style must persist across 5+ images. KDP coloring books, ad-campaign creatives, character-consistent multi-shot reels. Lock once, thread to every image in the batch.
style_ref_locked_aesthetic.fragment: in the exact line-art style of the reference image, match the line weight and decorative density of the reference
negative_constraints: do not deviate from the reference style
do not introduce shading not present in the reference

imagen-4-standard.syntax: URL in array — describe style explicitly in prompt too

imagen-4-ultra.syntax: URL in array — describe style explicitly

recraft-v4-raster.syntax: URL in array — describe style explicitly

gpt-image-2.syntax: URL in array, prompt mentions 'in the style of the reference'

character_ref_identity_lock.name: Character reference (lock identity across shots)
character_ref_identity_lock.use: Same person/character in N different scenes. Multi-shot ad campaigns, dictation app demos with same actor, kids book main character. Lock face + clothing + body type via reference.
character_ref_identity_lock.fragment: the character shown in the reference image, preserve facial features and clothing exactly, only the pose and environment change
negative_constraints: do not introduce a different person

flux-2-dev.syntax: URL in array — 1-2 refs work best

imagen-4-standard.syntax: URL in array; weight is loose, describe character in prompt

gpt-image-2.syntax: URL + 'preserve the person's identity from the reference' in prompt

product_ref_appearance_lock.name: Product reference (lock product appearance — Puck v3 lesson)
product_ref_appearance_lock.use: Hero product shots where the product MUST look exactly like the real one. EDC blade, dictation device, packaging. Lock 1-3 reference images of the actual product, scale, color, materials. Do NOT describe the product in prose alone — that drifts.
product_ref_appearance_lock.fragment: the product shown in the reference image, exact scale and proportions, exact materials and color, the same physical object placed in a new scene
negative_constraints: do not change scale or proportions
do not invent details not visible in the reference
do not change color or materials

nano-banana-pro.syntax: @img1 (multi-image composition is NB2's strength — pass product + environment refs together)

flux-2-pro.syntax: URL in array — describe scale explicitly in prompt

imagen-4-standard.syntax: URL + describe product attributes in prompt

gpt-image-2.syntax: URL + 'preserve the product exactly as shown' in prompt

layout_ref_composition_lock.name: Layout/sketch reference (lock composition)
layout_ref_composition_lock.use: When you have a rough sketch, wireframe, or composition study and want the model to render it in a specific aesthetic. Storyboard frames, ad layout mockups, UI wireframes turned into hi-fi.
layout_ref_composition_lock.fragment: follow the composition and layout shown in the reference sketch, preserve element placement and proportion, only refine the rendering quality and aesthetic
negative_constraints: do not move the focal point
do not crop differently than the reference

flux-2-dev.syntax: URL in array; FLUX has decent layout adherence with refs

gpt-image-2.syntax: URL + 'render this composition in [aesthetic]' edit-style instruction

recraft-v4-raster.syntax: URL + describe layout intent — Recraft has good design-aware layout adherence
